capabilities: Fetch today's incomplete Apple Reminders via reminders-cli
Append reminders as checklist items under the ## TODO heading of the daily note
Preserve reminder notes as indented text and show priority markers
Deduplicate items so repeated syncs don't create duplicates
Exclude configured reminder lists and sync on an interval or on vault open
disambiguation: One-way sync only: reminders are pulled into Obsidian, but edits in Obsidian are never pushed back to Apple Reminders.
extras: macOS only (EventKit is unavailable on Windows/Linux/iOS); the daily note must already contain a ## TODO heading; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull tasks from Apple Reminders into daily notes, so tasks must be copied by hand.

relations.evidence: Fetches incomplete reminders due today from Apple Reminders via reminders-cli

summary: macOS plugin that pulls today's incomplete Apple Reminders into the ## TODO section of your daily note as checklist items.
